40020143.author: पदार्थः
40020143.content: हन्यमाने being killed, बले (his) army, तस्मिन् that, पद्मनाभेन by Padmanabha, पृष्ठतः from behind, माल्वान् Malvan, सन्निवृत्तो turned back, अथ then, वेलाम् the shore, एत्य having reached, इव like, अर्णवः the ocean.

40020143.author: Translation
40020143.content: When his army was being struck from behind by Padmanabha, Malvan then turned back, like the ocean reaching its shore.

40020144.author: पदार्थः
40020144.content: संरक्तनयनः with bloodshot eyes, कोपात् from anger, चलन्मौलिः with a trembling crown, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (demon), पद्मनाभम् to Padmanabha, इदम् this, प्राह spoke, वचनम् word, पुरुषोत्तमम् to the best of men.

40020144.author: Translation
40020144.content: With bloodshot eyes from anger and a trembling crown, the demon spoke these words to Padmanabha, the best of men.

40020145.author: पदार्थः
40020145.content: नारायण O Narayana, न not, जानीषे you know, क्षात्रधर्मम् the warrior's duty, पुरातनम् ancient, अयुद्धमनसः those not intent on fighting, भीतान् frightened, अस्मान् us, हंसि you kill, यथा like, इतरः a common person.

40020145.author: Translation
40020145.content: O Narayana, you do not know the ancient duty of a warrior, as you kill us, who are frightened and not intent on fighting, like a common person.

40020146.author: पदार्थः
40020146.content: पराङ्मुखवधम् killing those who have turned their back, पापम् a sin, यः who, करोति does, असुरेतरः one who is not a demon, सः that, हन्ता killer, न not, गतः gone, स्वर्गम् heaven, लभते obtains, पुण्यकर्मणाम् of those with meritorious deeds.

40020146.author: Translation
40020146.content: Whoever, not being a demon, commits the sin of killing those who have turned their back, that killer does not attain the heaven of those who perform meritorious deeds.

40020147.author: पदार्थः
40020147.content: युद्धश्रद्धा desire for battle, अथवा or, ते to you, अस्ति is, शङ्खचक्रगदाधर O holder of conch, discus, and mace, अहम् I, स्थितः standing, अस्मि am, पश्यामि I see, बलम् strength, दर्शय show, यत् which, तव your.

40020147.author: Translation
40020147.content: Or if you have a desire for battle, O holder of conch, discus, and mace, I am standing here; show me the strength that is yours.

40020148.author: पदार्थः
40020148.content: माल्यवन्तं Malyavan, स्थितं standing, दृष्ट्वा having seen, माल्यवन्तम् Malyavan (mountain), इव like, अचलम् an immovable mountain, उवाच spoke, राक्षसेन्द्रं to the king of Rakshasas, तं him, देवराजानुजः the younger brother of the king of gods, बली the powerful one.

40020148.author: Translation
40020148.content: The powerful younger brother of Indra, seeing Malyavan standing like an immovable mountain, spoke to that king of Rakshasas.

40020149.author: पदार्थः
40020149.content: युष्मत्तः from you, भयभीतानां of those terrified, देवानां of the gods, वै indeed, मया by me, अभयम् fearlessness/protection, राक्षसोत्सादनं the destruction of Rakshasas, दत्तं was given, तत् that, एतत् this, अनुपाल्यते is being maintained.

40020149.author: Translation
40020149.content: I indeed granted protection and the destruction of Rakshasas to the gods who were terrified of you, and that promise is now being fulfilled.

40020150.author: पदार्थः
40020150.content: प्राणैः than life, अपि even, प्रियं dear, कार्यं deed/duty, देवानां of the gods, हि indeed, सदा always, मया by me, सः that, अहं I, वः you, निहनिष्यामि will kill, रसातलगतान् even if gone to Rasatala, अपि even.

40020150.author: Translation
40020150.content: Indeed, the welfare of the gods is dearer to me than my own life, and therefore I will kill you all, even if you hide in the lowest netherworld.

40020151.author: पदार्थः
40020151.content: देवदेवं the god of gods, ब्रुवाणं speaking, तं him, रक्ताम्बुरुहलोचनम् whose eyes were like red lotuses, शक्त्या with a spear, बिभेद pierced, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, राक्षसेन्द्रः the king of Rakshasas, भुजान्तरे in the chest.

40020151.author: Translation
40020151.content: The greatly enraged king of Rakshasas pierced the chest of the god of gods, whose eyes were like red lotuses, with a spear as he was speaking.

40020152.author: पदार्थः
40020152.content: माल्यवत्भुजनिर्मुक्ता released from Malyavan's arm, शक्तिः the spear, घण्टाकृतस्वना making a bell-like sound, हरेः of Hari, उरसि on the chest, बभ्राज shone, मेघस्था situated in a cloud, इव like, शतह्रदा lightning.

40020152.author: Translation
40020152.content: The spear, released from Malyavan's arm with a bell-like sound, shone on Hari's chest like a flash of lightning in a cloud.

40020153.author: पदार्थः
40020153.content: ततः then, ताम् एव च that very (weapon) also, उत्कृष्य having drawn out, शक्तिम् the spear, शक्तिधरप्रियः the beloved of the wielder of Shakti (Vishnu), माल्यवन्तम् Malyavan, समुद्दिश्य having aimed at, चिक्षेप threw, अम्बुरुहेक्षणः the lotus-eyed one.

40020153.author: Translation
40020153.content: Then, the lotus-eyed Vishnu, dear to the wielder of Shakti, drew out that very spear and hurled it, aiming at Malyavan.

40020154.author: पदार्थः
40020154.content: स्कन्दोत्सृष्टा इव as if thrown by Skanda, सा शक्तिः that spear, गोविन्दकरनिस्सृता released from Govinda's hand, काङ्क्षन्ती desiring (to strike), राक्षसम् the demon, प्रायात् went, माहेन्द्री इव like Mahendri (Indra's thunderbolt), अञ्जनाचलम् (towards) Anjana mountain.

40020154.author: Translation
40020154.content: That spear, released from Govinda's hand, flew towards the demon as if thrown by Skanda, desiring to strike, just as Indra's thunderbolt strikes the Anjana mountain.

40020155.author: पदार्थः
40020155.content: सा that (spear), तस्य his, उरसि on the chest, विस्तीर्णे broad, हारभारावभासिते shining with many necklaces, अपतत् fell, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the king of demons, गिरिकूट इव like a mountain peak, अशनिः a thunderbolt.

40020155.author: Translation
40020155.content: That spear fell upon the broad chest of the king of demons, which was shining with many necklaces, just as a thunderbolt strikes a mountain peak.

40020156.author: पदार्थः
40020156.content: तया by that (spear), भिन्नतनुत्राणः with his armor shattered, प्राविशत् entered, विपुलम् deep, तमः darkness (unconsciousness), माल्यवान् Malyavan, पुनराश्वस्तः having regained consciousness again, तस्थौ stood, गिरिः इव like a mountain, अचलः unmoving.

40020156.author: Translation
40020156.content: With his armor shattered by that spear, Malyavan fell into deep unconsciousness, but then regained consciousness and stood unmoving like a mountain.

40020157.author: पदार्थः
40020157.content: ततः then, कार्ष्णायसम् made of black iron, शूलम् a spear, कण्टकैः with spikes, बहुभिः many, वतम् covered, प्रगृह्य having seized, अभ्यहनत् struck, देवम् the god, स्तनयोः of the breasts, अन्तरे in the middle, दृढम् firmly.

40020157.author: Translation
40020157.content: Then, seizing a black iron spear covered with many spikes, Malyavan firmly struck the god between his breasts.

40020158.author: पदार्थः
40020158.content: तथैव just so, रणरक्तस्तु indeed eager for battle, मुष्टिना with a fist, वासवानुजम् the younger brother of Vasava (Vishnu), ताडयित्वा having struck, धनुर्मात्रम् a bow's length, अपक्रान्तः retreated, निशाचरः the demon.

40020158.author: Translation
40020158.content: The demon, eager for battle, struck Vishnu (Upendra) with his fist and then retreated a bow's length.

40020159.author: पदार्थः
40020159.content: ततः then, अम्बरे in the sky, महान् a great, शब्दः sound, साधुसाध्विति 'well done, well done' thus, चोदितः arose, आहत्य having struck, राक्षसः the demon, विष्णुम् Vishnu, गरुडम् Garuda, च and, अपि also, अताडयत् struck.

40020159.author: Translation
40020159.content: Then a great cry of "well done, well done" arose in the sky as the demon, having struck Vishnu, also struck Garuda.

40020160.author: पदार्थः
40020160.content: वैनतेयः Garuda, ततः then, क्रुद्धः enraged, पक्षवातेन with the wind from his wings, राक्षसम् the demon, व्यपोहत् blew away, बलवान् powerful, वायुः wind, शुष्कपर्णचयम् a heap of dry leaves, यथा just as.

40020160.author: Translation
40020160.content: Enraged, Garuda then blew away the demon with the powerful wind from his wings, just as a strong wind scatters a heap of dry leaves.

40020161.author: पदार्थः
40020161.content: द्विजेन्द्र king of birds (Garuda), पक्षवातेन by the wind from the wings, द्रावितम् driven away, दृश्य having seen, पूर्वजम् his elder brother, सुमाली Sumali, स्वबलैः with his own forces, सार्धम् together with, लङ्काम् towards Lanka, अभिमुखः facing, ययौ went.

40020161.author: Translation
40020161.content: Seeing his elder brother (Malyavan) driven away by the wind from Garuda's wings, Sumali, along with his own forces, headed towards Lanka.

40020162.author: पदार्थः
40020162.content: पक्षवात wind from the wings, बल force, उद्धूतः tossed up, माल्यवान् Malyavan, अपि also, राक्षसः the demon, स्वबलेन with his own forces, समागम्य having rejoined, ययौ went, लङ्काम् towards Lanka, ह्रिया with shame, वृतः overcome.

40020162.author: Translation
40020162.content: Malyavan, the demon who was tossed up by the force of the wing-wind, also rejoined his forces and went towards Lanka, overcome with shame.

40020163.author: पदार्थः
40020163.content: एवं thus, ते those, राक्षसाः Rākṣasas, तेन by that, हरिणा Hari (Vishnu), कमलेक्षण O lotus-eyed one, बहुशः many times, संयुगे in battle, भग्नाः defeated, हतप्रवरनायकाः having their chief leaders killed

40020163.author: Translation
40020163.content: O lotus-eyed one, those Rākṣasas were repeatedly defeated in battle by that Hari (Vishnu), having their chief leaders slain.

40020164.author: पदार्थः
40020164.content: अशक्नुवन्तः being unable, ते they, विष्णुं Vishnu, प्रतियोद्धुं to fight against, भयार्दिताः afflicted by fear, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, लङ्कां Lanka, गताः went, वस्तुं to dwell, पातालं to Pātāla, सहपत्नयः along with their wives

40020164.author: Translation
40020164.content: Being unable to fight against Vishnu and afflicted by fear, they abandoned Lanka and went to dwell in Pātāla along with their wives.

40020165.author: पदार्थः
40020165.content: सुमालिनं Sumālin, समासाद्य having approached, राक्षसं Rākṣasa, रघुसत्तम O best of Raghu's lineage, स्थिताः remained, प्रख्यातवीर्याः renowned for valor, ते they, वंशे in the lineage, सालकटङ्कटे of Sālakaṭaṅkaṭa

40020165.author: Translation
40020165.content: O best of Raghu's lineage, those Rākṣasas, renowned for their valor, joined the Rākṣasa Sumālin and settled in the lineage of Sālakaṭaṅkaṭa.

40020166.author: पदार्थः
40020166.content: ये those who, त्वया by you, निहताः killed, ते those, तु indeed, पौलस्त्याः descendants of Pulastya, नाम named, राक्षसाः Rākṣasas, सुमाली Sumālī, माल्यवान् Mālyavān, माली Mālī, ये those who, च and, तेषां their, पुरःसराः leaders

40020166.author: Translation
40020166.content: The Rākṣasas of the Pulastya lineage whom you killed, O Rama, include Sumālī, Mālyavān, Mālī, and their other leaders.

40020167.author: पदार्थः
40020167.content: सर्वे all, तेभ्यः than them, महाभागाः O highly fortunate one, रावणात् than Rāvaṇa, बलवत्तराः more powerful

40020167.author: Translation
40020167.content: O highly fortunate one, all of them were more powerful than Rāvaṇa.

40020168.author: पदार्थः
40020168.content: न not, च and, अन्यः another, राक्षसान् the Rākṣasas, हन्ता killer, सुरारीन् the enemies of the gods, देवकण्टकान् the tormentors of the gods, ऋते except, नारायणं Nārāyaṇa, देवं the god, शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् who holds the conch, discus, and mace

40020168.author: Translation
40020168.content: No one else can kill the Rākṣasas, who are enemies and tormentors of the gods, except for the god Nārāyaṇa, who holds the conch, discus, and mace.

40020169.author: पदार्थः
40020169.content: भवान् You, नारायणः Nārāyaṇa, देवः the god, चतुर्बाहुः four-armed, सनातनः eternal, राक्षसान् the Rākṣasas, हन्तुम् to kill, उत्पन्नः born (manifested), हि indeed, अजेयः unconquerable, प्रभुः lord, अव्ययः imperishable

40020169.author: Translation
40020169.content: You are indeed the eternal, four-armed god Nārāyaṇa, manifested to kill the Rākṣasas, and you are the unconquerable, imperishable lord.

40020170.author: पदार्थः
40020170.content: नष्टधर्मव्यवस्थाता one who re-establishes the lost order of Dharma, काले काले from time to time, प्रजाकरः creator of beings (or protector of subjects), उत्पद्यते is born (manifests), दस्युवधे for the destruction of villains, शरणागतवत्सलः affectionate towards those who seek refuge

40020170.author: Translation
40020170.content: He, who is affectionate towards those who seek refuge, manifests from time to time to re-establish the lost order of Dharma, protect beings, and destroy villains.

40020171.author: पदार्थः
40020171.content: एषा this, मया by me, तव to you, नराधिप O king of men, राक्षसानाम् of the Rākṣasas, उत्पत्तिः origin, अद्य today, कथिता narrated, सकला complete, यथावत् properly, भूयः further, निबोध understand (listen), रघुसत्तम O best of Raghu's lineage, रावणस्य of Rāvaṇa, जन्मप्रभावम् the power of birth (origin and might), अतुलं incomparable, ससुतस्य along with his sons, सर्वम् all

40020171.author: Translation
40020171.content: O King of men, I have today narrated to you the complete and proper origin of the Rākṣasas; now, O best of Raghu's lineage, listen further to the entire incomparable power and birth of Rāvaṇa along with his sons.

40020172.author: पदार्थः
40020172.content: चिरात् for a long time, सुमाली Sumālī, व्यचरत् wandered, रसातलं in Rasātala (the netherworld), सः that, राक्षसः Rākṣasa, विष्णुभयार्दितः tormented by fear of Viṣṇu, तदा then, पुत्रैः with sons, च and, पौत्रैः with grandsons, च and, समन्वितः accompanied, बली powerful, ततः then, तु indeed, लङ्काम् to Laṅkā, अवसत् resided (or occupied), धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth (Kubera)

40020172.author: Translation
40020172.content: For a long time, that powerful Rākṣasa Sumālī, tormented by fear of Viṣṇu, wandered in Rasātala accompanied by his sons and grandsons, while the lord of wealth (Kubera) then resided in Laṅkā. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टमः सर्गः ।। 8 ।। Thus ends the eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
